retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

score.note: player 1 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "MSX Hi-Score" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, BCD (RetroAchievements leaderboard "MSX Hi-Score" and code notes, from tools/ra_notes.py), to confirm in game

lives.note: player 1 lives, like the 1UP on screen (the game counts the current life, deduced, to be confirmed)

lives_p2.note: player 2 lives, like the 2UP on screen (the game counts the current life, deduced, to be confirmed)

weapon.note: player 1 weapon (cheat database Select Shot Equipment PL1, RetroAchievements code notes): 0 handgun, 1 MS cannon, 2 shotgun, 3 rocket launcher, 4 flame shot, 5 heavy machine gun, 6 laser, 7 to 11 the big shotgun, rocket launcher, flame shot, machine gun and laser, 12 enemy chaser, 13 iron lizard, 14 drop shot, 15 super grenade; the same codes as Metal Slug 3

prisoners.note: player 1 rescued prisoners (cheat database, Get 50 Prisoners Now! PL1)

prisoners_p2.note: player 2 rescued prisoners (cheat database, Get 50 Prisoners Now! PL2)

p1_chr.note: player 1 soldier (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Character, address swapped, one byte before his lives): 0 Marco, 1 Eri, 2 Tarma, 3 Fio; to confirm in game

p2_chr.note: player 2 soldier, same codes (RetroAchievements code notes, P2 - Character)

vehicle_kind.note: player 1 vehicle (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 - Vehicle ID, address swapped): 1 on foot, 4 Metal Slug (tank), 6 Slug Flyer; the camel of mission 2 to find; to confirm in game

vehicle.note: player 1 in a vehicle: the same byte less one, 0 on foot, 3 and more aboard

vehicle_hp.note: energy of player 1's vehicle in % (full at 0x30; cheat database Infinite Vehicle Energy PL1), shown while he is in it

vehicle_ammo.note: cannon shells of player 1's vehicle (cheat database Infinite Vehicle Cannon PL1), shown while he is in it

vehicle_kind_p2.note: player 2 vehicle, same codes (RetroAchievements code notes, P2 - Vehicle, 0x24 further like the cheat database's energy and cannon)

vehicle_p2.note: player 2 in a vehicle, the same byte less one

vehicle_hp_p2.note: energy of player 2's vehicle in % (cheat database Infinite Vehicle Energy PL2)

vehicle_ammo_p2.note: cannon shells of player 2's vehicle (cheat database Infinite Vehicle Cannon PL2)

_veh1.note: probe (1.33 test 21): player 1's vehicle block as it is, to confirm the kind and find the camel from a capture

time.note: timer (cheat database, Infinite Time writes 90), to be confirmed in game

mission.note: mission number, 0-based in RAM (cheat database "Select Starting Mission"), to be confirmed in game, missions 1 to 6: another value is not read (Metal Slug read 183 while it booted)

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

p1_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 1 stick and buttons (P1CURRENT): 0x04 left, 0x08 right, 0x10 A. Fires the handgun and scrolls the HD backdrop, to be confirmed in game

p2_input.note: Neo Geo BIOS, player 2 stick and buttons (P2CURRENT), same bits
